taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-14, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 161.1 | 3.39 | 3.39
2 | 1022.2 | 1.76 | 5.15
3 | 85.2 | 1.93 | 7.08
4 | 88.8 | 9.77 | 16.85
5 | 117.4 | - | -

What is the curve type of this station? Give a short answer, then end with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type": "<letters>"}

To determine the curve-type notation for the vertical electrical sounding (VES) at station T-14, we examine the resistivity values of the five layers in depth order:

1.  **Layer 1:** 161.1 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$
2.  **Layer 2:** 1022.2 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$
3.  **Layer 3:** 85.2 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$
4.  **Layer 4:** 88.8 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$
5.  **Layer 5:** 117.4 $\Omega\cdot\text{m}$

Next, we group them into consecutive sets of three:

*   **Layers 1-2-3:** 161.1 < 1022.2 > 85.2. This follows the pattern $\rho_1 < \rho_2 > \rho_3$, which corresponds to the letter **K**.
*   **Layers 2-3-4:** 1022.2 > 85.2 < 88.8. This follows the pattern $\rho_2 > \rho_3 < \rho_4$, which corresponds to the letter **H**.
*   **Layers 3-4-5:** 85.2 < 88.8 < 117.4. This follows the pattern $\rho_3 < \rho_4 < \rho_5$, which corresponds to the letter **A**.

Combining these letters in depth order, we get KHA.

{"curve_type": "KHA"}
